audience.text: Developers needing fast, non-blocking image format detection and metadata extraction without full decoding, especially in web or batch processing pipelines.

capabilities.text: Detects 14 image formats by reading only signature bytes using ImageProbe.DetectFormat() without decoding pixels.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: ImageProbe.Probe() reads width, height, bit depth, and frame count directly from format-specific headers.
capabilities.title: Header probing

capabilities.text: Counts real frames in GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU by walking container structures like image-descriptor blocks and IFD chains.
capabilities.title: Multi-frame counting

capabilities.text: Provides both synchronous and asynchronous entry points (ProbeFile/ProbeFileAsync, Probe/ProbeAsync) for non-blocking I/O.
capabilities.title: Async support

capabilities.text: Returns partial ImageInfo with only Format set for malformed or truncated files instead of throwing exceptions.
capabilities.title: Robust error handling

capabilities.text: Implements all format parsing natively with no external package references, declared in the main project file.
capabilities.title: Zero dependencies

limitations.text: Only performs format detection and header probing; does not decode, render, edit, or convert pixel data.
FrameCount is only populated for GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU; other formats return fixed 1.
Classic (non-placeable) WMF headers lack bounding rectangles, so Probe returns format-only ImageInfo.
DICOM parsing stops at the first undefined-length element, such as sequences or encapsulated pixel data.
CDR support is planned but not yet implemented; no CdrFormatHandler exists in the current source tree.

problems_solved.text: Avoids full image decoding just to determine format and basic properties like dimensions, bit depth, and frame count.
Provides format detection and header parsing for less common formats like PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF without external dependencies.
Enables safe, unattended processing of untrusted files by returning partial results instead of throwing exceptions on malformed headers.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging.Foss is a free, open-source .NET library for image format detection and header probing with zero dependencies, targeting netstandard2.0 and net8.0.

uncertainties: The exact set of 14 supported formats is implied but not enumerated in facts; only the README lists them.
Whether AVIF/HEIC grid images report full canvas dimensions is described in the README but not verified by symbol facts.
The behavior of DJVU frame counting for indirect (multi-file) DJVM documents is described but not confirmed by symbols.
The exact transfer syntaxes supported for DICOM parsing beyond Implicit VR LE and Explicit VR LE/BEE are not specified in facts.
The behavior of non-seekable stream handling for DetectFormat and Probe is described but not proven by symbols.
The nullable ImageInfo fields (Width, Height, BitDepth, FrameCount) are described but not fully verified by symbols.
The exact test framework versions (xUnit, coverlet) are mentioned in the README but not in facts.
The release workflow behavior for version tagging and publishing is described but not fully verified by facts.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Clone the repository and run dotnet build Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln, then dotnet test Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln to execute the test suite.

workflows.name: CI validation
workflows.text: Continuous integration runs on Ubuntu and Windows using workflows in .github/workflows/ to validate builds and tests.

workflows.name: Release publishing
workflows.text: Tagged pushes trigger .github/workflows/release.yml to build and publish the package.
